articles.summary: Completed Type A meeting with the FDA on bitopertin and aligned that the Phase 3 APOLLO study, if successful, can serve as the basis for CRL response; topline data expected in Q4 2026 Launched Expanded Access Program (EAP) for bitopertin for eligible erythropoietic protoporphyria (EPP) patients
